description: This file defines interfaces for shared storage management, including setting, getting, deleting key-value pairs, namespace management, storage limits, and cache control within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace.

classes.name: ISharedStorage
classes.description: Interface for shared storage operations including set, get, delete, and notification management.

classes.name: ISharedStorageInspector
classes.description: Interface for inspecting storage contents such as keys, namespaces, and sizes.

classes.name: ISharedStorageLimit
classes.description: Interface for managing storage size limits per namespace.

classes.name: ISharedStorageCache
classes.description: Interface for cache control, such as flushing the cache.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for storage events.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in a specified namespace with optional TTL.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a key in a specified namespace.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from a namespace.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys in a namespace.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.
